name: read-without-a-delivery-channel-answers-not-mountable
description: The locator resolves and the caller owns it, but the server wires no way to deliver a component — neither a static component URL nor a live channel. The read answers NOT_MOUNTABLE on -32006 rather than handing back a shell with nothing to mount. This is the branch that proves the invariant is about the RESULT, not the lookup: the lookup succeeded.
